messages:
alex: Morning team — quick triage check. Queue: 24 open (5 new). Hotlist: 1) payment-webhook errors, 2) embeddings regression, 3) Dedicated onboarding stuck for Customer-A. I cleared 6 tickets overnight. Blocker: we need a short macro for embeddings rollback + confirmation wording before we run it. I'll cover until 11:30 then hand off. Reply if you can take anything. pinging @oncall-eng.

maria: taking payment-webhook. Seeing 500s originating from upstream provider; temporary mitigation is retry -> backoff. I'll open a ticket to add a circuit-breaker flag in the client.

sam: grabbing embeddings regression. Can someone paste the rollback macro? Need exact model tag and the telemetry checks.

jin: putting macro below — use it and react when executed. Also include this quick log snippet I saw:
`ERROR: embeddings: vector_size_mismatch: expected 1536 got 1024`

jin: ```
Macro: Embeddings - rollback and customer message
- Rollback to: embedding-v2-20240201
- Steps:
  1) pin route to model tag `embedding-v2-20240201`
  2) flush prefix cache: `POST /admin/cache/flush?prefix=emb-*`
  3) monitor embeddings_latency and vector_consistency for 15m
  4) if errors persist, escalate to eng-oncall with ticket link
- Customer reply template:
  "Thanks for flagging — we observed a regression in the latest embedding model. We've rolled traffic back to a stable model (embedding-v2-20240201) and are monitoring. We'll follow up in 30m with metrics."
```

sam: thanks — will run the pin+flush at 10:20 and post results. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: [deploy-check] no active deploys in last 30m; safe to pin traffic.

alex: great. Maria — if payment needs an official postmortem, mark it P1 and loop in eng-payments. Also schedule a quick sync for Customer-A at 13:00, invite includes runbook + timeline.

maria: noted. I'll add postmortem template to the ticket and grab the payments runbook link.

sam: rollback done at 10:21, embedding telemetry shows similarity_recall back to baseline after 4m. Posting screenshots to ticket.

alex: perfect. If anyone hits a blocker that needs infra help, ping eng-infra or @jin directly. Otherwise I'll take the 11:30 handoff but please leave notes in the ticket macros field. Link to macros doc: https://redwood.docs/triage/macros#embeddings
